answer_1.quote: The task of table-to-text generation aims to take a structured table t as input and output a natural language description ...
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions of the input tables

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU (BL) and PARENT (PR) results ... BLEURT results are in Appendix ...

answer_4.quote: We further conducted a human evaluation study ... Crowdworkers were presented with an uncompressed image of a table, its page and section title, and a model generated description. Participants were asked to determine whether a description was "True" or "False" based on the information provided in the table and/or its title and subtitle.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to decide if each generated description was true or false with respect to the table and its title/subtitle.
